summary.edit_wall_us_note: includes a defensive copy of the value list (O(slots)); an in-place product edit is a tokenize plus two assignments

note: No training anywhere: the 256 glue is loaded and its parameters are hashed before and after, so zero-train is measured rather than asserted. A value never enters its own key (ctx_fp excludes it at write time), so the edit leaves keys bit-identical — an update, not a re-index. Each fact is edited on its own view of the tape and scored free-form with no candidate set, on the half of the facts 256 never fit. The second edit checks the tape tracks the latest write instead of behaving like a write-once cache.
